//: The driver catalogs org.webosphoenix.hardware trusts (docs/DRIVERS.md). Phoenix's catalog key is pinned here, in the system image: a driver catalog is never trusted on first use, as drivers install as root. key is null until the owner makes the key (docs/DRIVERS.md, "Releasing the catalog": drivers.php keygen) and puts its public half here; until then the service lists the hardware and offers nothing. When the key moves, the old key signs a hand-over (key-handover.json) and devices follow it; a key in revoked is never trusted again, whatever signs it (a leaked key: a system update adds it here, with the new key). reportUrl: where the opt-in hardware report goes.
